question: What is the primary purpose of a professional nursing organization?

options.A: To supply medical drugs to clinics
options.B: To train doctors in emergency care
options.C: To advance nursing practice and protect practitioners
options.D: To run private hospitals for profit

explanation: Professional nursing bodies exist to support practitioners, set standards, and advance the profession as a whole. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h1)

question: Why is unity among nurses through professional bodies important in healthcare systems?

options.A: It prevents doctors from making clinical diagnoses
options.B: It ensures all nurses receive equal salaries nationwide
options.C: It eliminates the need for hospital management teams
options.D: It gives nurses a stronger voice in policy decisions

explanation: A collective body allows nurses to advocate effectively for better working conditions and health policies. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h1)

question: A key benefit of joining a nursing professional association is gaining access to what resource?

options.A: Free housing accommodations in the city
options.C: Automatic promotions to senior medical ranks
options.D: Updated clinical guidelines and research journals

explanation: Professional associations regularly publish materials that keep members informed about current evidence-based practices. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h2)

question: How does professional networking within an nursing organization help a young clinician?

options.A: It removes the requirement for annual license renewal
options.B: It allows them to open a pharmacy without a permit
options.C: It guarantees them a scholarship abroad
options.D: It connects them with experienced mentors for career guidance

explanation: Networking opens doors to mentorship, professional support, and career advancement opportunities. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h2)

question: What is the primary focus of the International Council of Nurses (ICN)?

options.A: Providing direct patient care in disaster zones
options.B: Uniting nursing associations globally and setting international standards
options.C: Licensing individual nurses to practice in rural Nigerian clinics
options.D: Setting the specific salary scale for state hospitals

explanation: The ICN is a federation of national nurses associations working to represent nurses worldwide. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h3)

question: A major difference between national and international nursing bodies is that national bodies focus on...

options.A: Country-specific labor rights and local healthcare challenges
options.B: Writing textbooks for every nursing school worldwide
options.C: Issuing international passports to travelling clinicians
options.D: Global pandemics without considering local laws

explanation: National organizations deal directly with the unique industrial and professional needs within their specific country. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h3)

question: What do professional organizations draft to guide the moral conduct of nurses?
explanation: Codes of ethics provide the foundational moral rules and duties expected of every practicing nurse. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h4)

question: Why do professional bodies actively lobby government agencies regarding nurse-to-patient ratios?

options.A: To prevent staff burnout and protect patient safety
options.B: To increase the cost of nursing school tuition fees
options.C: To reduce the number of working hours for doctors
options.D: To ensure hospitals purchase expensive foreign equipment

explanation: Proper staffing ratios are vital for reducing medical errors and maintaining high standards of patient care. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h4)

question: What is a major reason professional organizations provide continuing education programs?

options.A: To test students before they enter clinical wards
options.B: To help nurses keep up with medical and technological changes
options.C: To replace traditional nursing school diploma programs
options.D: To generate revenue to build private commercial businesses

explanation: Continuing education ensures that practicing clinicians stay updated on modern healthcare practices. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h5)

question: How does continuing professional development directly affect a nurse's practicing license in Nigeria?

options.A: It grants automatic promotion to the director of nursing
options.B: It exempts the nurse from paying professional dues
options.C: It allows the nurse to retire early with a full pension
options.D: Credits earned are often required for annual license renewal

explanation: Regulatory councils frequently tie license renewal to the completion of verified professional development units. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T5#GNS112_U1_T5_h5)
